fields.headline: Adds $225,000 for 2025-26 to a City of Oakland summer internship stipend grant, raising it to $900,000
fields.summary: This amendment to a grant agreement with the City of Oakland, funded by the Oakland Fund for Children and Youth, adds $225,000 for stipends for students in summer internships in the Linked Learning program Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO). The amendment itself isn't attached in Legistar (the attachment is a different item's document), but the City's later amendment (26-0512) shows this is the grant's 2025-26 year, raising it from $675,000 to $900,000.

25-2573.sourceIssue: The PDF attached to this item in Legistar is a different item's document (file 25-2753, an Oakland Symphony amendment), so the grant amendment itself isn't in the record.
